row.name: Republic Military Discipline
row.description: Characters with Republic military training are drilled in discipline, teamwork, and tactical awareness. This reflects their commitment to order and coordinated action within a large organization. Benefits: Fearlessness 2 (4 points) (representing their steadfastness in combat). Sense of Duty (To the Republic, 5 points) (representing their loyalty to the galactic government). +1 to Leadership (IQ/Average) and Tactics (IQ/Hard) skills. (These bonuses apply after buying skill levels.) While serving a presumed "good" cause, this discipline can lead to following morally questionable orders, participating in collateral damage, or prioritizing the chain of command over individual morality in the name of the Republic.
